category.description: Core v0.1 categories are unknown-field, deprecated, migration, unknown-capability-field, unknown-capability-value, yanked-version, stale-trust-evidence-only, insufficient-current-trust-evidence, noncanonical-entrypoint, and external-dependency-potential-exposure.
